description: Source code defining the ShuffleMapStage class in Apache Spark, representing intermediate stages in the execution DAG that produce data for shuffles, including methods for managing active jobs, pending partitions, and shuffle output availability.

classes.name: ShuffleMapStage
classes.description: Represents an intermediate stage in Spark's execution DAG responsible for producing shuffle data, managing associated jobs, and tracking partition outputs.

methods.name: mapStageJobs
methods.description: Returns the list of active jobs associated with this shuffle map stage.

methods.name: addActiveJob
methods.description: Adds a job to the list of active jobs for this stage.

methods.name: removeActiveJob
methods.description: Removes a specified job from the list of active jobs.

methods.name: numAvailableOutputs
methods.description: Returns the number of shuffle outputs that are available for this stage.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if all shuffle outputs are available, indicating the stage is ready.

methods.name: findMissingPartitions
methods.description: Identifies which partitions are missing and need to be computed.
